g.text: A cross of any depth meets 880 ns: one level per step
REF bare metal · the cross is message 9 of a 10-message packet: buy 900 @ a3, three levels deep
a1: merge heads of lanes 3, 17 by (rx_ts, lane),
one Segment16 sweep each · continuation steps, ARC-D14
Fill a1 300 · then a2, a3 from s+1, s+2 (+15 each)
320 + 45 + 50 + 10 + 100 + 15 + 60 + 40 + 240 = 880 ns, a maximum at every sweep depth.
The taker gets one Fill per level; each maker gets one Fill per order hit (§6.14).
